name: failure-modes
description: The four ways agent memory fails that retrieval questions do not measure (t_72d6eb23): proactive know-to-ask with a false-fire term, write-back fidelity through the shipped extraction path, cross-source isolation under a strict owner-scope gate, and the tokens actually injected. The vault sets integrity.owner_scope_delivery to fail because the shipped default is off, under which no scope is evaluated and an isolation gate would be vacuous.
